values: Equality in the Fradelizi–Paouris–Schütt second-moment inequality — Alec Kriebel, v1.0.0. Preprint date: 2026-09-23; published on Zenodo: 2026-09-26. Affirmative resolution of OWR-4136-011: equality holds exactly for nondegenerate simplices with every vertex of norm r, for all n≥1. Four-page unrefereed, AI-assisted preprint; two fresh sequential adversarial reviews found no actionable issues. Includes exact verifier (298 checks, 18 cases), source comparison, and bounded priority audit.
